title: Krul Plugin Record
description: One newline-delimited JSON line emitted by a krul indexer plugin. Validated by kruld before DB insertion. kind/partition values are NOT enumerated here — they're checked at runtime against whichever ontology file the project's krul.toml points at (see ontologies/dv-uvm.json for the shipped DV/UVM example, ontologies/stock-ta.json for an unrelated second example). This schema only enforces record shape.

EntityRecord.title: Entity Record
EntityRecord.description: Declares one entity to be inserted into the project's knowledge graph.

partition.description: Ontology-defined grouping label for kind. Must match the kind field per the loaded ontology's kind→partition mapping, enforced by the daemon at insert time, not by this schema.

kind.description: Entity kind, checked against the loaded ontology's entity_kind list.

file.description: Absolute path to the source file containing this entity.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence in [0,1]. Below 0.5 triggers a daemon warning.

properties.description: Kind-specific optional properties. Names and meanings are defined by the plugin/ontology pair, not by krul's core contract.

RelationRecord.title: Relation Record
RelationRecord.description: Declares one typed directed relationship between two entities already declared in this stream or present in the DB.

kind.description: Relation kind, checked against the loaded ontology's relation_kind list.

properties.description: Relationship-specific properties. Names and meanings are defined by the plugin/ontology pair, not by krul's core contract.
